== Research Notes ==

Identity revalidation, 17 October 2026: The printed page identifies George Cargill as bookseller and Alison as his bride on 11 March 1651. A nearby George Cargill, printer, marries Elspeth Orme in 1663; it is a second documentary occurrence and is not asserted to be the same husband. Newly completed Allison/Alesoun/Alisoun Glasgow and Alisone/Alice Glesgow API variants returned no historical Open candidate. Neither bookseller’s parentage nor Alison’s father is given here.

The supplied occurrence records George Cargill. Completed exact and variant live searches found no supported compatible profile. === Record review, 30 September 2026 ===
The printed Edinburgh marriage register records Alisone Glasgow and George Cargill, bookseller, on 1651-03-11.<ref>Henry Paton, ed., ''Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700'' (Scottish Record Society, 1905), printed pp. 267 and 116, PDF pp. 277 and 126, [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=126 scanned edition]. Printed page images inspected 30 September 2026; original parish image uninspected. The unnumbered Prefatory Note, PDF p. 9, identifies the dates in register volumes I–II as marriage dates. Adult identification with a candidate profile is assessed separately.</ref>
